content: Now we have windows working with wx 3.3.4, and have the xml information sorted, I think, what do we do about all the other platforms? A sample xml header for each of the supported platforms and environments would be useful.

Nothing changes on any other platform at the moment (except flatpak adding 26.08 runtime in 5.16 and flatpak runtime 24.08 being EOL and removed). Only 64bit Windows are using wx 3.3 now because it is supporting the native dark mode. At the moment, I can't guarantee we won't find something on macOS that also deserves switch to 3.3 before O5.16.
